customer_acct: Hi, we're seeing very slow streaming responses from the Node/edge SDK when using ReadableStream — tokens arrive in 2–5s bursts instead of steady flow. Also noticed some 401s mid-stream and unexpected billing spikes. Can someone help?

support_ellie: Sorry you're hitting this. Can you share the SDK version + which runtime (vercel/edge runtime/node) and a short repro? Also paste the last few response headers if possible.

customer_acct: Using @redwood/sdk v0.14.2 (installed via npm), running on Vercel Edge Functions (edge runtime). Repro steps: 1) call chat.stream with streaming: true 2) rotate auth token during the stream 3) observe chunked delays. Quick snippet:```js
const res = await client.chat.stream({model:'gpt-open', messages});
for await (const chunk of res) { console.log(Date.now(), chunk); }
```
Headers snippet from last request: `x-request-id: r-12ab`, `x-edge-latency: 150ms`, `content-type: text/event-stream`. Billing: saw 2x token counts compared to non-streaming call.

support_ellie: Thanks. Two things to check quickly: 1) Are you using the edge-specific SDK build? v0.14.2 has separate bundles for node vs edge. 2) Token rotation mid-stream should cause a 401 and the SDK should attempt a retry — could produce duplicate token accounting if retries are full requests.

devx_jordan: @customer_acct can you confirm which import you use? e.g. `import { createEdgeClient } from '@redwood/sdk/edge'` vs `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'`? Also pinging @eng_runtime_lee since chunk pacing + auth rotation sounds runtime-related.

customer_acct: Using `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` (commonjs-ish). We didn't know there was an edge bundle. We rotate tokens via a mutable header callback that replaces Authorization mid-request. Example:```js
const client = new Redwood({ getAuth: () => currentToken }); // token swapped async
```

eng_runtime_lee: A few observations: 1) Edge bundle uses native fetch + ReadableStream and handles SSE framing differently. 2) If you swap Authorization in-flight and the SDK retries by re-issuing a full request, the server may re-send chunks from start which looks like doubled tokens. 3) The 2–5s bursts suggest batching logic kicking in because the runtime or polyfill is buffering small writes.

infra_oncall: Can you paste a small debug trace? If you enable DEBUG=redwood:stream we can see retry events and chunk timing. Also please capture the `x-retry-count` header and `x-request-id` for failed attempts.

customer_acct: Enabled DEBUG, here's an excerpt (sanitized):
```
[2190192020.123] stream:start r-12ab
[2190192021.500] stream:chunk r-12ab chunkSize=128
[2190192023.700] auth:token-swapped old=tok_a new=tok_b
[2190192023.905] stream:retry r-12ab retry=1 code=401
[2190192025.100] stream:chunk r-12ab chunkSize=512
```
Billing_team: Noted the double-count concern — if retries are full-request replays then tokens can be billed twice, especially on hosted plans. We'll need request-level dedupe or server-side idempotency for streaming.

devx_jordan: Two immediate action items: 1) For customer - try switching to edge bundle import: `import { createEdgeClient } from '@redwood/sdk/edge'` and re-run. 2) Avoid rotating Authorization mid-stream; instead use short-lived session tokens that can be refreshed only between requests.

support_ellie: Also please try v0.15.0-rc1 where we've fixed a retry-path bug that causes full-request replays on 401 during streaming. If you can repro on rc1, ping and we'll escalate.

customer_acct: Re-tested with edge import + rc1: chunking became steady (sub-200ms). No duplicated token billing seen in short run. However when we forcibly revoke token mid-stream still saw a clean stream termination with a single 401 and no replay — looks much better.

eng_runtime_lee: Great signal. We'll open an internal ticket to backport the retry fix to stable release and add server-side safeguards (stream idempotency, retry headers). I'll attach logs and request-ids.

billing_team: We'll review the billing spike for the earlier incident and issue an adjustment if duplicates were billed. Please send exact invoice lines and request-ids.

support_ellie: Marking this resolved for now. If you see it again please re-open with DEBUG logs and `x-request-id`. Thanks! :thumbsup:

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-453. Assigned to eng-runtime-lee, priority: P2.
